name: Easy Leaflet Map
author: Nashir Uddin

sections.description:
Add a map generated with LeafletJS: a leading open-source JavaScript library for mobile-friendly interactive maps.
Map tiles are provided by default through OpenStreetMap, do not need an API Key. or Google Map with API Key or Bing Map with an API Key.
Can be set map with manual and auto generated shortcode based on the dashboard settings.

Map

How to use Easy Map – Video Tutorial

Key Features

  1. Map Zoom Control: Allow users to manage zoom control.
  2. Map Height: Allow users to adjust map height as per their preference.
  3. Popup Message: Users can added HTML and Media supported Marker Popup message.
  4. Zoom Control Position: Allow users to manage zoom control position.
  5. Scroll Wheel Zoom: Allow users to manage Scroll Wheel Zoom.
  6. Full Screen Control: Allow users to manage Full Screen Control.
  7. Tile Layer: Multiple tile layer supported.
  8. Map Location: Multiple location supported.
  9. Map Drawings: Multiple Drawings option supported.
  10. Gutenberg Block : Gutenberg Block editor supported.

Why Choose This Plugin?

  1. User-Friendly Interface: Simple to configure and customize.
  2. Optimized for Performance: Lightweight and built to ensure fast loading times.
  3. Responsive Design: Fully compatible with all devices and screen sizes.

Easily create a map with auto generated shortcode like:

[easy-map ID="168"]
[easy-map-marker ID="1"]
[easy-map-marker ID="2"]
[easy-map-drawing ID="1"]

Easily create a map with manual shortcode like:

[easy-map]
[easy-map lat='37.2811806' lon='-122.0569443' ]
[easy-map lat='37.2811806' lon='-122.0569443' zoom='12']
[easy-map lat='37.2811806' lon='-122.0569443' zoom='12' popup='Silicon Valley']
[easy-map lat='37.2811806' lon='-122.0569443' zoom='12' tilelayer='google']

Easily create a map marker with latitude , longitude :

[easy-map lat='23.010228300829105' lon='91.38879596106436' ]
[easy-map-marker lat=23.010228300829105 lon=91.38879596106436 popup='Dhaka']

Support

For support, feature request, or any inquiries, please email at nashirbabu@gmail.com
sections.installation:
1. Choose to add a new plugin, then click upload
  2. Upload the easy-map zip
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  4. Use the shortcode in your pages or posts: e.g. [easy-map]
